topic: Colors and marking on naval aircraft
syllabus_extract: Colors and marking on naval aircraft.
specific_objectives: 6.2.1.1 Trainee will be able to understand surface protection materials, paint identification, restoration of various paint and application, dope shop, dope articles and troubles.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Paint sample identification exercise; Safety: Wear gloves and eye protection; Supervision: Instructor monitors sample handling.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of aircraft paint?
Name one function of surface protection materials.
Where is the dope shop typically located on a naval aircraft?

development.content:
Surface protection materials types
Paint identification codes and colors
Restoration of various paint types
Paint application methods

Dope shop layout and organization
Dope articles and equipment usage
Common troubles and defect identification
Safety protocols in paint areas

Practical paint sample identification
Review of restoration techniques
Troubleshooting common paint defects
Q&A session on specific queries

summary_questions: Explain the difference between dope and standard aircraft paint.
List three common troubles encountered in the dope shop and their solutions.
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report on the preservation phases and materials used, linking paint restoration to preservation requirements for the next lesson.

pft_rows.syllabus: A/c preservation phases and types of preservation Materials used for preservation, recording procedures when a/c placed in preservation.
